errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the presence of a legend in the top-right corner of the plot, which is essential for identifying which line corresponds to "0-CoT" and which to "CoRe".

While the description for the "CoRe" line includes all five data points, the description for the "0-CoT" line omits the data points at x=2 (approx. 0.939) and x=3 (approx. 0.926), providing an incomplete account of its trajectory compared to the other series.
